## Line Chart

The layer-matrix **Line Chart** element: a self-contained SVG trend line with no chart library. `@points` ({label, value}[]) and an optional `@formatValue` for axis and endpoint labels. Renders an area fill, a faint dashed grid at min/mid/max, the line, and an emphasized endpoint with its value — the endpoint IS the headline number, so the chart reads correctly even at small sizes.

```gts
import { LineChart } from '../line-chart';
<LineChart @points={{this.mrrByMonth}} @formatValue={{this.money}} />
```

Colors route through theme tokens (`--primary`, `--border`, `--muted-foreground`) so a theme restyles it without touching the block.

**Non-goals:** multiple series, tooltips and hover, time-axis math (points arrive ordered; bucketing is the consumer's job), donut and bar variants.
